description: rnews_ingest.rs test_rnews_ingest_two_articles_e2e verifies that the CID stored in msgid_map matches pr.cid (line 161-163), but it does not verify that the bytes retrieved from the IPFS store under that CID actually contain the expected article content. run_pipeline prepends a Path: header (prepend_path_header), so the stored bytes differ from the parsed article_bytes. The test has no assertion that a get_raw(cid) roundtrip recovers parseable, correct content. As a result, a bug in prepend_path_header that produces corrupt bytes would not be caught by this test — the CID would still match. Correct behavior: the test should retrieve the stored block from MemIpfsStore and assert that the expected headers (Message-ID, Newsgroups, From) are present and correct in the stored bytes, providing an independent oracle for content fidelity.
title: SEC0: test makes no assertion about article content fidelity after round-trip
